Name: Roxfreeze's Character Portrait (Content Patcher)
Author: Roxfreeze
Description:
Hello! I am learning pixel art hoping to develop my own games in the future. This project starts as a challenge for myself to draw SD characters in my style. After this project is done, I pluck up all my courage and try to publish it as a mod for everybody to use. Allow me to give you a quick guide about this mod:


[size=4][b]What Will I Find in This Mod?[/b][/size]

Mostly orient style pixel art, which feels similar to Japanese manga. If you like to see the original characters in a different style, this might be your cup of tea.
I also changed two characters' sprites, because I altered their portrait for some reason: 

[list]
[*]Elliott: I am fond of one of his early concepts, so I took my favorite one instead of the final concept in game. Now he hides a secret from everyone, but maybe you can discover it. With the power of friendship, I suppose?
[*][spoiler]Krobus: Kind of want to see a more human-like shadow people, but unfortunately I can't alter the sprite's height. Now you get a tiny shadow hooman, I guess.[/spoiler]
[/list]

[b][size=4]How Do I Use This Mod In Stardew Valley?[/size][/b]

First, you need to have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] for this mod to work. Put all the folders in Stardew Valley's mod folder, no need to extract anything, and it should work properly. Since this mod is not designed to be compatible with other mods that changes portraits or sprites. Only in this case, you can merge my contents with other mods. [b]Please note: you do NOT have permission to re-upload, edit portraits/sprites or use any portraits/sprites in other games.
[/b]

[size=4]There is An Update of Stardew and Your Mod is No Longer Compatible. What can I do?[/size]

Please DM me on[b] [/b][url=https://twitter.com/home]Twitter[/url], and[b] mind your courtesy while making a request[/b]. I believe most of you do, but there are always exceptions. If I am already working on it, I will update this description.


[size=4]I Really Want to Use These Portraits Outside of Stardew Valley, Can I Get A Permission?
[/size]
First: It is okay to stream SDV with this mod. For other usages, please DM me on Twitter. [b]I might not grant your request according to my own judgement, [/b]please do not expect to always get a positive answer. [b]Again: you do NOT have permission to re-upload, edit portraits/sprites or use any portraits/sprites in other games unless I permit it.[/b]


[b][size=4]Is There A Way To Support?[/size][/b]

I'm still figuring out how Paypal connects with Nexus. For now you can consider [url=https://ko-fi.com/roxfreeze]Kofi[/url]. If you ever considered to support me, I genuinely appreciate that.
